name: Rehmin
indication_description:
Rehmin is indicated in-
  • Leucorrhoea
  • Weakness of uterus
  • Menstrual irregularity
  • Dysmenorrhoea
  • Uterine inflammation
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Betel nut (Areca catechu), Bengle kino (Butea monosperma) and other natural ingredients; it acts as an astringent, anti-inflammatory and emmenagogue. This tablet tones up and restores the normal functions of uterus, prevents urinary discharge; particularly useful for watery discharge from vagina. It is also very effective in leucorrhoea and menstrual irregularity.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) twice daily before meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
